$comment: Contract for the AddQuestion server-side command (AD-003, AD-122). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_AddQuestion
customApi.description: Creates a question and its first version in a section of the checklist version in force. Enforces the caller holds Edit on question.retire and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: SectionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_section to add the question to.

requestParameters.name: QuestionCode
requestParameters.description: Unique code for the question, for example Q-E1-06.

requestParameters.name: Name
requestParameters.description: Short name for the question row.

requestParameters.name: Wording
requestParameters.description: Question text as the reviewer reads it.

requestParameters.name: Mandatory
requestParameters.description: 'true' or 'false'. Absent is treated as true.

requestParameters.name: DisplayOrder
requestParameters.description: Optional integer order within the section. Absent appends after the highest.

requestParameters.name: EffectiveFrom
requestParameters.description: Optional yyyy-MM-dd. Absent is today. May not be in the past.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same question.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
